instruction: What's my favorite grocery store, and what do I actually buy there? Rank my stores and give me a quick profile of my shopping habits in LibreOffice Writer.
required_subtasks: Open Kwik-E-Mart and list all stores Michael has ordered from
Count orders per store and rank them
Identify the top store by Michael's Kwik-E-Mart order count (plurality, not necessarily majority) from /api/orders
Scan the line items at the top store to characterize what Michael typically buys there
Give a one-paragraph profile of Michael's Kwik-E-Mart shopping preference

rubrics.criterion: Agent identifies the favorite grocery store from the live Kwik-E-Mart order history under a basis it states or makes evident — order count or total spend are both defensible readings of 'favorite'
Agent reports the live per-store figures for that basis across every store and ranks the stores by it
Agent accurately characterizes the typical line items bought at the top-ranked store
Agent writes a concise shopping-habits profile grounded in the favorite store's order history
Agent uses the Kwik-E-Mart order-history rows and line items as the evidence source rather than inventing a preference
Agent creates a LibreOffice Writer document containing the complete store ranking and shopping-habits profile
